workarounds.title: Composer aliases for broken 2.4.4 package constraints
workarounds.detail: Magento 2.4.4 does not resolve as shipped. Require magento/security-package:1.1.3-p1 as 1.1.3 and magento/inventory-metapackage:1.2.4-p1 as 1.2.4 before composer install.

workarounds.title: Elasticsearch 8 needs magento/module-elasticsearch-8
workarounds.detail: Stock 2.4.6/2.4.7 only talk to Elasticsearch 7. Add "replace": {"magento/module-elasticsearch-7": "*"} to composer.json and composer require magento/module-elasticsearch-8. The public mirrors carry builds that resolve on 2.4.6-p10+ and 2.4.7-p5+; earlier patch releases need the build from repo.magento.com.

workarounds.title: ACSD-59280: ReflectionUnionType::getName() error
workarounds.detail: Adobe quality patch for 2.4.4 patch releases running on PHP 8.3.

workarounds.title: ACSD-46815: static content deploy fails with the compact strategy
workarounds.detail: Adobe quality patch; setup:static-content:deploy with the compact strategy fails without it. Built for 2.4.4, applies cleanly to 2.4.2 and 2.4.3 too.

workarounds.title: ACSD-46815: static content deploy fails with the compact strategy
workarounds.detail: Adobe quality patch; setup:static-content:deploy with the compact strategy fails on 2.4.5 without it.

workarounds.title: Elasticsearch XSD rejected by libxml2 2.12+
workarounds.detail: Fixes "complex type 'mixedDataType': The content model is not deterministic". Needed wherever PHP links libxml2 2.12 or newer. Patch by Pieter Hoste.

workarounds.title: GLOB_BRACE is undefined on Alpine/musl PHP
workarounds.detail: MvcApplication globs with GLOB_BRACE, which musl PHP below 8.5 does not define. Backports the Mage-OS 3.5.0 Filesystem\Glob fix. Not needed on glibc-based PHP.

workarounds.title: GLOB_BRACE is undefined on Alpine/musl PHP
workarounds.detail: Same GLOB_BRACE fix as Magento 2.4.9. Mage-OS 3.2 and later install on musl without it. Not needed on glibc-based PHP.
